title: Finite inverse lower-bound preservation
statement: For a site comparison C and a finite level n, if N.IsGE a then ((C.image.level n).inverse.obj N).IsGE a.

proof.text: The finite inverse derived functor is t-exact on bounded-below objects by the supplied exact-adjunction bounds.

proof_origin.place: Separated boundedness/construction step from Zheng Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 09B1.

lean.statement:
theorem exceptionalSiteOriginComparison_level_inverse_bound
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (ell : O)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (PE : StrictEtaleEvaluation T O ell)
    (C : ExceptionalSystemSiteComparison O ell T PE)
    (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (strictEtaleLevel T O ell n)) (a : ℤ)
    (hN : N.IsGE a) : ((C.image.level n).inverse.obj N).IsGE a
